turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog's breath could strip paint. What can I do?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Bad breath is often a sign of plaque or gum problems. A vet check is a good first step to look at his teeth.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, brushing is the gold standard. Use a dog toothpaste, never human, and a soft brush or a finger brush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He'd bite the brush in half.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start small. Let him lick the toothpaste off your finger for a few days, then rub his gums gently, and build up from there.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They help a bit, but they're not a replacement for brushing. Pick ones approved for dental health and count them as part of his food.
